messages.text: Hello Anuda, this is Nelum from Riverstone Mills in Galle. I am calling about your application for the stores clerk opening at our branch.
Hello Nelum, thank you for calling. I sent the application last week and I am still interested in the stores clerk post.
The interview is on Monday at 9:00 at the Galle office, floor 1. Bring a printed CV and a copy of your NIC.
I can attend. Is there any form charge or uniform payment before the interview?
No. Riverstone Mills does not charge a registration fee, a deposit, or a kit cost. You only meet the supervisor.
If I am selected, how is the monthly pay arranged?
The salary is LKR 47000 a month, paid by payroll into your bank account after the contract is signed.
Thank you. I will bring the CV and the NIC copy, and I will be at the Galle office on Monday at 9:00.

Thanks. CV ekai NIC copy ekai genna Kurunegala office ekata Monday 9:00 ta ennan.
